clue.text: Diana given emphasis when much troubled

parts.note: Di is the usual short form of the name Diana
a word given emphasis is stressed

explanation.surface: A woman called Diana speaks forcefully when she is very upset.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone much troubled is upset and anxious, exactly the sense of being in distress.

clue.text: Lied about drink I swallowed producing wild excitement

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the letters of the word before are rearranged
swallowed means the letter is taken inside the drink

parts.note: rum is a spirit drink

explanation.surface: Someone lied about drinking and ended up in a frenzy.
explanation.definitionFit: Delirium is a state of frenzied, uncontrolled agitation or ecstasy.

clue.text: Son fixed gates — that's most wise

indicators.note: fixed here means repaired or reworked, so the letters of the word after are rearranged

explanation.surface: A son mends the gates, a very sensible thing to do.
explanation.definitionFit: Sage means wise, so its superlative means wisest.

clue.text: Concerning speck far away

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a mote is a speck of dust

explanation.surface: Something about a tiny speck in the distance.
explanation.definitionFit: A remote place is distant and isolated.

clue.text: Place one can retire to

parts.note: retire means go to bed, and 'one' hints at a single sleeper

explanation.surface: Sounds like a retirement location for someone leaving work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retire' means go to bed, and 'one' is literal: a bed for one person.
explanation.definitionFit: A bed sized for one sleeper is where a person goes when retiring for the night.

clue.text: It comes from the postman in a manner of speaking

definitions.meaning: the post a letter carrier brings each morning
a speaker's style of speech, as in an orator's diction

explanation.surface: A postman brings things and has his own way of talking.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both the mail dropped at the door and the way a speech is spoken.

clue.text: Method of transmitting data initially with information found inside

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of each of the four words that follow

explanation.surface: A description of a data protocol that hides information within something.
explanation.definitionFit: Wireless networking is a standard way for devices to send data over radio rather than cables.

clue.text: Capsizing, risk a wet runner

indicators.note: a boat capsizing is turned over and its contents thrown about, so the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A capsized boat leaves a crew member soaked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runner' looks like an athlete; it is a ski, which runs over the surface like a sledge runner.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner is a blade or strip that slides along, like the skis used to skim across a lake.

clue.text: Enthusiast played it as a free musical composition

parts.note: a fan is an enthusiast

indicators.note: played suggests notes performed in another order, so the letters of the words after are rearranged

explanation.surface: A music lover performed a piece freely.
explanation.definitionFit: A fantasia is an instrumental piece in free form, unbound by strict structure.

clue.text: Melting a disintegrating fibrous tissue

indicators.note: something disintegrating falls apart, so the letters of the two words before are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Something melting and breaking down turns out to be connective tissue.
explanation.definitionFit: A tough band of fibrous connective tissue joins bones together at a joint.

clue.text: Flat entrance partly concealed

indicators.note: partly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: The door into an apartment is half hidden from view.
explanation.definitionFit: Something latent is present but not yet visible or developed, hence hidden.

clue.text: Pay again and move house

definitions.meaning: to settle a bill is to pay it, so doing it once more
to settle somewhere new, establishing a home in a different place

explanation.surface: Someone pays a second time and then relocates.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as re-settle it means paying a debt again; as one word it means relocating to a new home.

clue.text: Part of speech a student's not written

parts.note: a verb is one of the grammatical parts of speech
L, for learner, is the usual crossword student, from the L-plates on a learner driver's car

explanation.surface: A grammar point about a student's spoken, not written, language.
explanation.definitionFit: A verbal agreement or message is spoken rather than set down on paper.

clue.text: Insect, queen having drink

parts.note: a bee is an insect
R is short for regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A bug and a queen sharing a drink, as in a fairy tale.
explanation.definitionFit: Ale or lager is a common alcoholic beverage brewed from malt and hops.

clue.text: Choose examination of voters

parts.note: to elect is to choose
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: Picking an exam for the electorate.
explanation.definitionFit: Electoral describes anything relating to elections and the people voting in them.

clue.text: Be wrong about motorway hazard

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's best-known motorway, written here as MI
to hazard money is to stake it, so a stake is a sum hazarded

explanation.surface: A driver misjudges a danger on the motorway.
explanation.walkthrough: The digit 1 in M1, the London-to-Leeds motorway, is read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: To misjudge or misidentify something is to get it wrong, the transitive verb sense.

clue.text: Fashionable retreat provided during aeroplane journey

parts.note: in means fashionable
flight is fleeing, a retreat

explanation.surface: A trendy holiday escape taken while flying.
explanation.definitionFit: In-flight services happen while an airliner is in the air.

clue.text: Very little evidence that one has been crying

definitions.text: Very little evidence that one has been crying

parts.words: Very little evidence that one has been crying
parts.note: the tiniest proof of weeping is a single bead of liquid from the eye

explanation.surface: Someone denies weeping, and there is scarcely any proof.
explanation.definitionFit: A single drop shed from the eye is the smallest trace of weeping.

clue.text: County fortunate not starting to become a state

parts.note: Kent is a county in south-east England

indicators.note: not starting means the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: lucky means fortunate

explanation.surface: An English county is lucky enough to become an American state.
explanation.definitionFit: Kentucky is one of the fifty states of the USA.

clue.text: Car Lily damaged — wax it, perhaps, if feeling enthusiastic?

definitions.text: wax it, perhaps, if feeling enthusiastic

indicators.note: damaged suggests something knocked out of shape, so the letters of the two words before are rearranged

explanation.surface: Lily has dented her car and wonders whether a coat of wax will help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wax' looks like car polish; it is the old verb meaning grow or become, as in the idiom 'wax lyrical', to speak with gushing enthusiasm.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom to wax lyrical means to talk about something with great gushing enthusiasm.

clue.text: Nothing to cap flier's romantically demonstrative partner

indicators.note: in a down answer, to cap means to sit on top, so this piece comes first

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring
a bird is a flier

explanation.surface: A bird's partner shows affection with nothing held back.
explanation.definitionFit: Lovebird is an informal word for a doting partner, after the affectionate parrots.

clue.text: Margin found in middle of accounts book

indicators.note: the middle of a word drops its first and last letters, keeping only what lies between

parts.note: a ledger is a book of accounts

explanation.surface: A note in the margin of a book of accounts.
explanation.definitionFit: A margin is the border or rim of something, a close synonym.

clue.text: Main milk supplier?

parts.note: main is poetic for the ocean, and a milk supplier on a farm is a dairy animal

explanation.surface: Asking who is the chief source of milk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Main' looks like 'chief'; it is the old word for the open ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: The dugong or manatee is a marine mammal that suckles its young, a milk supplier of the ocean.

clue.text: Silver found in case on a temple

indicators.note: found in means the metal sits inside the case

parts.note: a pod is a seed case
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Silver discovered in a box placed on a temple.
explanation.definitionFit: A pagoda is a tiered tower temple of East Asia.

clue.text: Top two in class are taking temperature of wine

indicators.note: the top two of a word are its first two letters

explanation.surface: The best two pupils in a class are checking the temperature of the wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Claret is the British name for red Bordeaux, a wine from France.

clue.text: Beastly time in the cheapest accommodation?

parts.note: read as 'of a beast': a steer is a young castrated bull
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: An awful stay in budget lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beastly' looks like 'awful'; it is read literally as a beast, a steer.
explanation.definitionFit: Steerage was the lowest-fare passenger class on a ship, below decks near the rudder gear.

clue.text: A fish I caught — or mushroom?

parts.note: the gar is a long-snouted freshwater fish
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: An angler unsure whether the catch is a fish or a mushroom.
explanation.definitionFit: Agaric is the name for a gilled fungus such as the fly agaric.

clue.text: Vegetable giving brother terrible colic

parts.note: bro is informal short form for brother

indicators.note: terrible suggests something wrecked, so the letters of the word after are scrambled

explanation.surface: A green vegetable gives a sibling dreadful stomach pains.
explanation.definitionFit: Broccoli is a green brassica eaten for its flower heads.

clue.text: Remain second highest

parts.note: the top is the highest point

explanation.surface: Holding on in the runner-up position.
explanation.definitionFit: To stop somewhere can mean to stay there, as in stopping the night.

clue.text: Chicken-hearted eccentric's official warning

parts.note: yellow is slang for cowardly
a card is an amusingly eccentric person

explanation.surface: A cowardly oddball receives a formal caution.
explanation.walkthrough: In football the referee shows a yellow card as a caution.
explanation.definitionFit: In sport the referee's caution is shown by holding up this coloured card.
